title: Power Apps: model-driven apps as Business Applications in Work IQ
summary: Hold: the page incorrectly reports App Access automation as undocumented, although Dataverse documents an API for allowing or blocking applications. The roadmap facts and the other listed controls are supported; minor corrections concern conflicting documentation and a checklist control missing from the table.

claims.fix: Replace controls[3].api null with kind rest, call 'PATCH <organization-url>/api/data/v9.2/applications(<application-id>); Content-Type: application/json; body: {"access":1}', docs https://learn.microsoft.com/power-apps/developer/data-platform/webapi/reference/application. Add to its note: 'This call blocks the specified application; enable App Access using the UI first. Set access to 0 to allow it.' Replace the closing automation sentence with: 'Dataverse documents SaveSettingValue for app-setting overrides and the application table API for allowing or blocking applications; no automation equivalent was found for the remaining listed settings in November 2026.'
